title: Verify: focusChange and menuClose events deliver payloads
summary: Unit tests for the two new events
description: Extend the event bus unit tests so both new events are delivered to subscribers and can be unsubscribed.
acceptance_criteria: menuClose reaches the handler once and not after unsubscribe.
technical_constraints: Pure unit test, no Phaser needed

steps.action: Add test 'delivers focusChange': subscribe a vi.fn() with phaserToReact.on('focusChange', h), emit {id:'bookshelf'}, assert h toHaveBeenCalledWith({id:'bookshelf'}). Add test 'menuClose unsubscribes': subscribe h, emit {} once, call the returned unsubscribe, emit again, assert h toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserEvents.test.ts
